# Google (10 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /search | `query` | 1 | Google web search |
| /ad | `url` | 5 | Get Google ad details |
| /adlibrary/advertisers/search | `query` | 5 | Search Google Ad Library advertisers |
| /company/ads | `domain` / `advertiser_id` | 5 | List Google ads by company |
| /business/info | `keyword` / `cid` / `place_id` | 1 | Get a Google Business Profile |
| /business/extended-reviews | `keyword` / `cid` / `place_id` | 5 | Get Google extended (multi-source) reviews |
| /business/updates | `keyword` / `cid` | 1 | Get Google Business Profile posts (updates) |
| /business/questions | `keyword` / `cid` / `place_id` | 5 | Get Google Business Profile questions & answers |
| /hotels/search | `keyword` | 1 | Search Google hotels |
| /hotels/info | `hotel_identifier` | 5 | Get Google hotel detail |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `query`: Search keyword or phrase
- `region` *(optional, string)*: 2 letter country code, ie US, UK, CA, etc This will show results from that country
- `date_posted` *(optional, enum: last-hour | last-day | last-week | last-month | last-year)*: Date posted
- `page` *(optional, integer)*: Page number to retrieve
- `url`: Ads Transparency Center CREATIVE URL — must include both the advertiser and creative segments (`…/advertiser/{AR…}/creative/{CR…}`). Get one from `/v1/google/company/ads`.
- `query (/adlibrary/advertisers/search)`: Search keyword or phrase to find advertisers in the Google Ads Transparency Center.
- `region (/adlibrary/advertisers/search)` *(optional, string)*: 2-letter country code to search in. Defaults to US.
- `domain` *(optional, string)*: Company domain name to look up ads for
- `advertiser_id` *(optional, string)*: The advertiser id of the company
- `topic` *(optional, enum: all | political)*: The topic to search for. If you search for 'political', you will also need to pass a 'region', like 'US' or 'AU'
- `region (/company/ads)` *(optional, string)*: The region to search for. Defaults to anywhere
- `start_date` *(optional, string)*: Start date to search for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
- `end_date` *(optional, string)*: End date to search for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
- `platform` *(optional, enum: google_maps | google_play | google_search | google_shopping | youtube)*: Google surface to filter ads by (e.g. youtube, google_search)
- `format` *(optional, enum: text | image | video)*: Ad format to filter by: text, image, or video
- `get_ad_details` *(optional, string)*: Set to true to get the ad details. Will cost 25 credits.
- `cursor` *(optional, string)*: Cursor to paginate through results
- `keyword` *(optional, string)*: Business name + address (e.g. 'Irving Farm New York 645 5th Ave'). Use cid/place_id when known for an exact match.
- `cid` *(optional, string)*: Google customer id (cid) of the place — the most reliable identifier.
- `place_id` *(optional, string)*: Google place_id of the place.
- `location_name` *(optional, string)*: Geographic context as 'City,Region,Country' (default 'New York,New York,United States').
- `language_name` *(optional, string)*: Result language (default 'English').
- `keyword (/business/extended-reviews)` *(optional, string)*: Business name + address. Use cid/place_id for an exact match.
- `cid (/business/extended-reviews)` *(optional, string)*: Google customer id (cid) of the place.
- `location_name (/business/extended-reviews)` *(optional, string)*: Geographic context as 'City,Region,Country'.
- `depth` *(optional, integer)*: Number of reviews to return (default 20, step 20, max 1000).
- `keyword (/business/updates)` *(optional, string)*: Business name + location (e.g. 'Toyota of Manhattan New York').
- `cid (/business/updates)` *(optional, string)*: Google customer id (cid) of the business.
- `location_name (/business/updates)` *(optional, string)*: Geographic context as 'City,Region,Country'.
- `keyword (/business/questions)` *(optional, string)*: Business name + location (e.g. 'Starbucks Reserve Roastery New York').
- `cid (/business/questions)` *(optional, string)*: Google customer id (cid) of the business.
- `place_id (/business/questions)` *(optional, string)*: Google place_id of the business.
- `location_name (/business/questions)` *(optional, string)*: Geographic context as 'City,Region,Country'.
- `depth (/business/questions)` *(optional, integer)*: Number of questions to return (default 20).
- `keyword (/hotels/search)`: Hotel search query (e.g. 'hotels in New York').
- `location_name (/hotels/search)` *(optional, string)*: Geographic context as 'City,Region,Country'.
- `check_in` *(optional, string)*: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the next day.
- `check_out` *(optional, string)*: Check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to one night.
- `hotel_identifier`: Opaque hotel id returned by GET /v1/google/hotels/search.
- `location_name (/hotels/info)` *(optional, string)*: Geographic context as 'City,Region,Country'.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/google/search?query=best restaurants in London" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
